description_en: Creates a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance
kebab_example: aliyun gwlb create-load-balancer --vpc-id vpc-uf6qcgpv22ttrnnjh0000 --zone-mappings ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-a VSwitchId=vsw-2f0eb0200000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en:
The IP version. Valid values:

Ipv4 (default): IPv4
parameters.help_zh:
协议版本。取值：

Ipv4（默认值）：Ipv4类型
parameters.name: address_ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The GWLB instance name.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
网关型负载均衡实例名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the zone. You can specify only one vSwitch (subnet) in each zone of a GWLB instance
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the DescribeZones operation to query the most recent zone list
fields.help_zh: 可用区ID，通过调用网关型负载均衡DescribeZones接口获得
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The mappings between zones and vSwitches. You must specify at least one zone. You can specify at most 20 zones. If the region supports two or more zones, specify at least two zones
parameters.help_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表。至少需要添加一个可用区，最多支持添加20个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，建议添加2个及以上可用区
parameters.name: zone_mappings

fields.help_en:
The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

It can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签健最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. It can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags that are added to the instance
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

LoadBalancerId.description_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例的ID
